steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's over now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: People always have a way of surpassing your expectations.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Even moreso when it comes to the Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Power begets madness, and desire begets depravity.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They are cancers, eroding away at all that is good in the world.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think this mask will have any particular significance for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you want to keep it, I won't stop you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just know that one day, your room will be filled with masks like this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All people must bear the consequences for the choices they make... Infected, or otherwise.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, I...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Listen, Amiya.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: These people... Reunion, if they're willing to listen to you, then you can do everything in your power to help them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But if they've decided to abandon the voices of reason and dedicate their lives to the pursuit of madness... You should not hesitate any longer.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She did no evil. Nor did we put an end to any evil here today.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This happened just because of a choice she made.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nobody has the right to stop her, and nobody has the right to blame her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know... I always felt that we had a duty to help those in need.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, why... did it have to end like this...? Why did she have to bear this consequence alone...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is what Rhodes Island is doing truly right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When one is infected with Oripathy, her life is no longer her own.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Perhaps through the eyes of Rhodes Island, those who are on the wrong path can still be redeemed...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But for me, and the L.G.D., that is not the case. If necessary, we might have to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just want to break this never-ending cycle...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if it's only bit by bit...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... if everything will just end up like this, then I can only...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you doubting yourself?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't now...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected seem to be doomed to death, either by the hands of hostiles, or through their own making.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This tragedy will only continue to repeat, again and again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In this vicious cycle of hatred, there is only one way for the Infected to regain hope, other than eliminating Oripathy itself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...And that is to cast aside these chains of thorns and put an end to hatred itself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Mercy comes at a cost that not all can afford.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Rhodes Island cannot become the L.G.D., nor can it do what the L.G.D. does.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Choosing the number of Infected that you're willing to accept, or choosing how many people to save through your benevolent methods... These are things that only Rhodes Island can do. Or rather...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: These are things that only Rhodes Island is willing to do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But, I cannot do these things...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And especially... not the L.G.D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: At least... you will also honor his memory, not just his comrades.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...If your room will be filled with masks, then so be it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Remember, this is your business, and no one else's.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My little 'leader' of Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you've already steeled yourself to bear this burden...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then make your decision, and accept the consequences.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D. will clear the scene before finishing up. Afterwards, I'll get in touch with that other doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, let's go.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Tsk... Peoples' fates always have a strange way of intertwining.

steps.name: W
steps.text: They cross with each other, and they clash with each other. Even a grandmaster can be put in check by unexpected developments.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But in the end, all is still well.

steps.name: W
steps.text: For at least... I can look forward to what the future has in store for us. Heh.
